caption: The drawing features five stylized birds arranged in two rows on a pale yellow or beige background. All of the birds are depicted in shades of blue with varying levels of detail and patterns, each perched on a branch or with a stylized base. In the top row, the bird on the left is in a side profile standing on a smooth curved branch with its head pointing forward, and on the right, a bird is positioned similarly but is perched on a branch with more pronounced leaves. In the middle row, a single bird faces right, perched on a branch, with a white patch on its body that distinguishes it from the other birds and curving tail feathers. The bottom row features two birds: the one on the left is more abstract and simplified in design, with minimal features and dot patterns on its wing, while the bird on the right is more anatomically detailed and stands on a curved branch. All birds are rendered in tonal variations of blue, without any additional colors aside from the background, and there are small numbers and labels beneath each bird.
title: Bird Decorations on Stoneware
